responsibility: Supplies the subtarget driver and linker specifications for bare-metal riscv*-elf targets. It defines the default linker emulation and endianness handling, chooses Newlib/libgloss-oriented default libraries and crt files, and selects the multilib-selection policy based on ABI, architecture, and code model, making this the OS-ABI glue layer for generic ELF embedded targets rather than Linux, FreeBSD, or RTEMS variants.
